description: Image Description: The image depicts a natural savanna landscape with two elephants, an adult and a juvenile, walking across a grassy plain. The adult elephant, positioned on the left side of the frame, is larger and has prominent tusks, a large ear, and a long trunk that is slightly curved downward. Its skin is gray and wrinkled, typical of African elephants. The juvenile elephant, located to the right and slightly behind the adult, is significantly smaller, with shorter tusks or none
